Follow the repository map in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Keep behavior simple and low-context:
- Prefer the most specific source of truth available.
- Read project and feature specs before implementation work.
- Use domain docs only when the task touches that area.
- Treat [docs/checklists.md](../docs/checklists.md) as operational support, not as source of truth.
- Respect the branch flow and commit conventions defined in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
- Avoid repeating rules already defined in docs or specs.
- Ask for clarification only when the task is genuinely ambiguous.
